# 100.00 USD prepaid to a supplier, paid out of a CAD bank.
#
# The claim on the vendor is a *debit* on the payable — positive, unlike a
# customer's credit, which is money owed back and sits negative on the
# receivable. That sign is why this shape can bring currency into the book
# again when the claim is later moved to a bank account, and the customer
# side cannot.
#
# Nothing in the transaction but these two splits: no second settlement, no
# other claim, nothing an unpost has loosened.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank:USD
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD
	type: Accounts Payable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Supplies
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:FX Gain
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

vendor "V-US"
	name: "US Supplier"
	currency: USD

2026-02-01 * "Prepaid the supplier 100 USD, paid in CAD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD 100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.37"
		value: "137.00"
		lot_owner: "vendor:V-US"
	Assets:Bank -137.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
